method: Staging-only temporary DOM telemetry: first numeric homeStatOpen, 50ms sampling; FCP from Performance API. No external telemetry. Ten sequential authenticated cloud Chrome desktop reloads; uncontrolled cache; nonrandomized; no physical Android or Saudi-network guarantee.
comparison_limit: Prior readiness sampling was 100ms; current sampling 50ms. Measurements are observations, not a controlled causal experiment. Readiness is the task counter only, not every home data source.

payload_estimate.scope: Aggregate SQL JSON size in staging for 371 undeleted rows, not compressed HTTP bytes or the authenticated manager's exact row scope
